findings.issue: The read-only preflight checks column names but ignores PRAGMA user_version. A version-2 index still passes and GET /video/<job> and /search expose retired frame-derived visual evidence that pipeline.index_connection invalidates when upgrading to LIBRARY_SCHEMA_VERSION=3. Reject unsupported index versions with migration_required without modifying the database.

summary: Fixed one W0 defect: read-only dashboard routes now reject unsupported library schema versions with migration_required, preventing retired visual evidence from bypassing the CLI migration gate while leaving database bytes unchanged. Git Bash UTF-8 validation passed 625 Python tests, 538 subtests and 94 widget scenarios (24 existing skips); 30 Windows sync checks and GitOps shell syntax checks also passed. The regression failed in all 12 version/route cases before the fix; all changes remain local with no push.
